mapper.sql: id, user_id AS userId, agent_code AS agentCode, title, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_conversation (user_id, agent_code, title) VALUES (#{userId}, #{agentCode}, #{title})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM agent_conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND agent_code = #{agentCode} ORDER BY update_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_conversation SET update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM agent_conversation WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
